snapshot.purpose: Map two official RMB/FirstRand role adverts to existing authored KAIRO practice and identify separate, proposed portfolio tasks for uncovered areas.
snapshot.not_a_fit_assessment: No learner fit score, eligibility conclusion, application recommendation or employer assessment is made. Practice choices and proposed projects are not equivalent to work experience, credentials or verified skill.
snapshot.status_caution: The advert details are from official-host indexed text; direct Workday opens returned no readable lines. Both indexed closing notes state applications are not accepted on 2026-10-23 or onwards. Timezone/cutoff hour are not stated. Live status is unknown; do not present either as a confirmed open vacancy.

roles.title: IT Business Analyst
roles.deadline_note: Applications are not accepted on the date indicated or onwards; submit ahead of 2026-10-23. Timezone and cutoff hour unspecified.

employer_requirements.requirement: Minimum eight years of Business Analysis or Business/Systems Analysis experience.
Demonstrable Market Risk, traded risk, financial-markets risk technology or closely related risk-domain experience.

Translate complex methodologies, policies or regulatory needs into implementable technology, data and control requirements; support complex change through testing and implementation validation; deliver across business, risk, data and technology stakeholders.
Relevant Bachelor’s degree or BTech in Computer Science, Information Systems, Mathematics, Engineering, Finance, Risk Management or a related discipline.
Agile delivery, named risk framework/regulatory exposure, relevant certification and coaching/mentoring are listed as preferred or advantageous.

practice_mapping.local_context: Northstar Study Circle is invented; its exported role context references Discovery's Business Analyst page, not RMB. The exercise does not represent or receive endorsement from either employer.

capability_overlap.case_activity: Clarify a vague request with competing stakeholder needs; revise the requirement; choose synthetic UAT cases and leave an unresolved policy rule gated for owner approval.
capability_overlap.boundary: This is a fictional, bounded requirements/UAT exercise; it does not evidence professional BA delivery, regulated change, stakeholder workshops at bank scale, or Market Risk knowledge.

capability_overlap.case_activity: No case activity can evidence a formal degree or its equivalence.
capability_overlap.boundary: The model does not infer that any learner's qualification meets the employer wording.

capability_overlap.case_activity: No case activity measures or substitutes for years of employment experience.
capability_overlap.boundary: The eight-year threshold remains unproven by practice or suggested project work.

capability_overlap.case_activity: The fictional reporting scenario contains no market-risk model, instrument, risk-factor, trading-book or regulatory framework content.
capability_overlap.boundary: Market Risk experience and domain knowledge remain unproven.

proposed_missing_project_work.task: Using only invented requirements and synthetic records, write a short change brief with three fictional stakeholder roles, 10 testable requirements, a current/future process map, a data-field lineage table, assumptions/decision owners and a trace from requirement to acceptance test.
proposed_missing_project_work.suggested_evidence: Versioned brief, process/data diagrams, traceability matrix and reviewed change log.
proposed_missing_project_work.limit: This demonstrates an authored portfolio artifact only; it is not evidence of eight years' experience or employer-accepted BA competence.

proposed_missing_project_work.task: Create 30 synthetic position/risk-report rows, seed six labeled data defects, and write eight SQL quality/reconciliation checks with expected results and source-to-output lineage.
proposed_missing_project_work.suggested_evidence: Synthetic dataset, SQL scripts, test cases and a concise defect/result log.
proposed_missing_project_work.limit: Do not claim regulatory compliance or implement a production VaR/FRTB calculation. Synthetic checks are not bank controls.

proposed_missing_project_work.task: Read the cited BIS market-risk standard and BCBS 239 material; produce a glossary and a one-page note distinguishing source statements, assumptions and questions requiring a qualified risk owner.
proposed_missing_project_work.suggested_evidence: Cited study notes with sections/page references and an explicit unknowns list.
proposed_missing_project_work.limit: Reading and summaries do not establish professional Market Risk experience or regulatory implementation skill.

roles.title: Trade Support Specialist
roles.deadline_note: Applications are not accepted on the date indicated or onwards; submit ahead of 2026-10-23. Timezone and cutoff hour unspecified.

employer_requirements.requirement: Three to five years of experience in a technology or production-support environment.
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Finance or a related field.

Support business-critical enterprise applications and integrated environments; experience with incident, problem, change and release management; and experience with vendors/cross-functional technical teams.
Exposure to trading systems or financial-markets technology is described as ideal.

The advert lists electronic trading/order routing/FIX/market-data, Linux/Unix, SQL, networking, troubleshooting, scripting/automation, monitoring/alerting, cloud/infrastructure, access controls and resilience under Technical and Functional Skills without individually marking each mandatory or preferred.

practice_mapping.local_context: Northstar Study Circle is invented; the source context references Discovery Digital Support, not RMB. This is not a trading platform or employer assessment.

capability_overlap.case_activity: Use privacy-safe triage, reproduce an issue with synthetic inputs, record uncertainty, escalate to an owner and avoid declaring resolution without confirmation.
capability_overlap.boundary: This is scripted digital-support practice; it does not demonstrate production incident ownership, service restoration, root-cause analysis, enterprise integrations, release/change operations, vendor management or trading-system support.

capability_overlap.case_activity: The scenario records practice choices, not time in a technology or production-support job.
capability_overlap.boundary: The three-to-five-year experience requirement remains unproven; practice and a portfolio project are not equivalent experience.

capability_overlap.case_activity: No case activity establishes a formal qualification or degree equivalence.
capability_overlap.boundary: The model makes no degree or eligibility inference.

capability_overlap.case_activity: The case concerns fictional sign-in and an inaccessible upload control; it contains no trade lifecycle or financial-market systems.
The case has no FIX messages, Linux/Unix host, network, database, alerting stack, or market-data feed.
capability_overlap.boundary: Technical skills from the advert are not inferred from safe support decisions.

proposed_missing_project_work.task: Build a local-only emulator with four fictional components and 50 synthetic order/status/market-data events. Seed five fault types such as stale feed, missing field, duplicate event, delayed response and unavailable downstream service; never connect to an exchange or real account.
proposed_missing_project_work.suggested_evidence: Architecture sketch, event schema, synthetic logs, fault catalogue and test fixtures.
proposed_missing_project_work.limit: This is a toy lab, not an electronic-trading platform, certified FIX implementation or proof of market-system operation.

proposed_missing_project_work.task: Write a triage runbook that distinguishes symptoms from causes; define safe checks, severity/impact questions, escalation owner, status updates, evidence preservation, and a rollback/restore decision for each seeded fault.
proposed_missing_project_work.suggested_evidence: Runbook, 10 simulated incident records, root-cause hypotheses labeled as unverified, and post-incident actions.
proposed_missing_project_work.limit: Simulated incidents do not prove production incident-management experience or service-level performance.

proposed_missing_project_work.task: Add deterministic schema and timing checks to the synthetic event lab; test the five seeded faults and two recoveries; document a simulated change, UAT checklist, alert threshold rationale and a rollback test.
proposed_missing_project_work.suggested_evidence: Automated local tests, sample alerts, change record, UAT results and rollback notes.
proposed_missing_project_work.limit: The project must remain disconnected from live networks, trading venues and real market data.

preparatory_sources.title: Minimum capital requirements for market risk
preparatory_sources.supports: Official Basel Committee reference material for the Market Risk/FRTB terminology present in the IT Business Analyst advert.
preparatory_sources.status_note: BIS page labels the standard consolidated and integrated into the Basel Framework; it states an effective date of 1 January 2022.
preparatory_sources.use_limit: A technical standard, not a beginner course or evidence of the learner's expertise. Read with the employer requirement; do not claim a toy portfolio project implements regulatory rules.

preparatory_sources.title: Principles for effective risk data aggregation and risk reporting
preparatory_sources.supports: Official principles include governance, data architecture, accuracy/integrity and completeness themes relevant to risk-data requirements.
preparatory_sources.use_limit: Official reference document; reading it is not a qualification or evidence of bank implementation experience.

preparatory_sources.title: Implementation of the Principles for effective risk data aggregation and risk reporting (BCBS 239 Principles)
preparatory_sources.supports: BCBS Newsletter 36 published 6 January 2026 summarizes implementation issues, including data lineage and governance; the page describes it as informational and not new supervisory guidance.
preparatory_sources.use_limit: Context for a study note only; it does not state RMB policy or an employer assessment.

preparatory_sources.title: FIX Protocol
preparatory_sources.supports: The protocol community describes FIX as an application-layer standard for structured orders, executions and market-data messages independent of transport.
preparatory_sources.use_limit: Official protocol reference; a local toy schema is not a production FIX system or trading-experience substitute.

preparatory_sources.title: Query and modify data with Transact-SQL
preparatory_sources.supports: Microsoft Learn describes a beginner, six-module T-SQL learning path listed as 5 hr 45 min.
preparatory_sources.use_limit: Learning content only; it does not satisfy degree, experience or role eligibility requirements.

preparatory_sources.title: The Python Tutorial
preparatory_sources.supports: Official Python language tutorial for basic scripting concepts relevant to the role's listed automation/scripting tasks.
preparatory_sources.use_limit: Language study only; it does not establish scripting proficiency or production-support experience.
